name: go
displayName: poly ref-lens: a stand-in for golang.go
description: Loaded beside poly-lsp in the ref-lens host and nowhere else. It has golang.go's id, which is all poly looks at to decide that golang.go's test commands exist, and golang.go's go.enableCodeLens setting exactly as 0.58.0 declares it, which poly's configurationDefaults turns off and poly reads to decide who draws the Go test lens.

runtest.description: If true, enables code lens for running and debugging tests

go.enableCodeLens.description: Feature level setting to enable/disable code lens for references and run/debug tests
